stories.title: Passenger Management & Cabin Selection

coverage.coverageSummary: Covers passenger category count management, dynamic summary updates, cabin default and single-select behavior, and proactive UI enforcement for adult minimum, infant-to-adult ratio, and max occupied seats=9. Includes positive, negative, and boundary scenarios with derived risk checks for infant-with-seat seat-occupancy inclusion, verifying control disablement/prevention (no inline/toast/modal errors).
coverage.coverageReason: All acceptance criteria are covered with positive, negative, and boundary cases, and clarifications confirm proactive UI restrictions (disabled steppers) with default counts (Adult=1, others=0) and no error messages to assert. Remaining minor uncertainty is limited to exact UI selectors/labels for controls and summary formatting.
coveredAreas: Passenger categories: Adult, Child, Infant, Infant With Seat
Increase/decrease passenger counts
Passenger summary dynamic update
Cabin selection: Economy default; single cabin selected at a time; Economy/Business/First options
Validation before search execution
Blocking conditions enforced proactively in UI: Adult cannot be 0; Infant cannot exceed Adult; Occupied seats cannot exceed 9
Occupied seats definition includes Adult, Child, Infant With Seat
Boundary at total occupied seats = 9 allowed
Default passenger counts: Adult=1, others=0
missingAreas: Stable identifiers/selectors for disabled state of passenger steppers and for passenger summary formatting/location
Whether 'Infant With Seat' has any additional constraints beyond counting as occupied seat

automationReadiness.reason: Clarifications confirm proactive UI enforcement with disabled controls and no error messages, making automation more deterministic. Minor risk remains in reliably locating the steppers, their disabled state, and the passenger summary across responsive layouts.

testCases.title: Verify Economy is selected by default in Passengers & Cabin
testCases.objective: Ensure default cabin selection is Economy when opening passenger and cabin configuration.
testCases.confidenceReason: Requirement explicitly states Economy must be selected by default; UI label/selector specifics may vary.
steps: Verify selected option Cabin equals Economy
testCases.expectedOutcome: Economy cabin is pre-selected by default when the configuration panel opens.
testCases.automationReason: Cabin selection state can be asserted via DOM attributes/text using Playwright.

testCases.title: Verify only one cabin class can be selected at a time
testCases.objective: Ensure selecting a cabin class deselects the previously selected cabin class.
testCases.confidenceReason: Single-select rule is explicit; exact UI implementation (radio vs buttons) may differ but still verifiable.
steps: Verify selected option Cabin equals Business
Verify selected option Cabin equals First
testCases.expectedOutcome: At any time, exactly one cabin class is selected; selecting Business then First results in First selected and Business not selected.
testCases.automationReason: Radio/button state can be validated via selected attributes/classes/text.

testCases.title: Increase Adult count and verify passenger summary updates dynamically
testCases.objective: Validate passenger count adjustments update the visible summary immediately.
testCases.confidenceReason: Dynamic update is stated, but summary format/location is not specified; may require selector tuning.
steps: Verify value Passenger summary contains Adult 2
testCases.expectedOutcome: Adult count increments by 1 and passenger summary reflects the new Adult total immediately; configuration can be saved via Continue.
testCases.automationReason: Stepper interaction and summary text/value assertion are automatable.

testCases.title: Decrease Adult count to zero and verify Search is blocked
testCases.objective: Ensure minimum one Adult validation is enforced before flight search execution.
testCases.confidenceReason: Clarification confirms UI prevents Adult=0 by disabling decrement control; test can reliably assert prevention rather than message-based blocking.
steps: Enter Abu Dhabi in Origin field
Select Abu Dhabi from airport suggestions
Verify value Adult passenger count equals 1
Verify Adult decrement control is disabled (cannot reduce below 1)
Attempt to decrease count Adult passengers by 1
Verify value Adult passenger count equals 1
testCases.expectedOutcome: Adult count cannot be reduced below 1 (decrement is disabled/prevented); configuration remains valid and no passenger-validation error message is shown for Adult minimum rule.
testCases.automationReason: Disabled state (or no-op click) can be asserted via DOM properties/attributes and count remaining unchanged; no dependency on error message rendering.

testCases.title: Set Infant count greater than Adult count and verify Search is blocked
testCases.objective: Enforce rule: Infant count must not exceed Adult count; one Adult can accompany only one Infant.
testCases.confidenceReason: Clarification confirms UI prevents invalid configurations proactively; test can assert Infant increment is disabled/prevented beyond Adult count.
steps: Enter Abu Dhabi in Origin field
Select Abu Dhabi from airport suggestions
Verify value Adult passenger count equals 1
Verify value Infant passenger count equals 1
Verify Infant increment control is disabled (cannot exceed Adult count)
Attempt to increase count Infant passengers by 1
Verify value Infant passenger count equals 1
testCases.expectedOutcome: Infant count cannot be increased beyond Adult count (increment is disabled/prevented); no passenger-validation error message is shown for the Infant-to-Adult rule.
testCases.automationReason: Disabled state/no-op click and count assertions are deterministic; does not require asserting any error copy/location.

testCases.title: Boundary: Occupied seats equals 9 should allow Search (Adults + Children + Infants With Seat)
testCases.objective: Validate maximum occupied seats rule at the allowed boundary of 9 seats.
testCases.confidenceReason: Clarification confirms UI prevents exceeding limits; boundary of 9 can be asserted via counts and enabled controls (or not-disabled increment until reaching 9).
steps: Enter Abu Dhabi in Origin field
Select Abu Dhabi from airport suggestions
Verify value Adult passenger count equals 9
testCases.expectedOutcome: Passenger picker allows configuration with total occupied seats of 9; passenger validation does not block search due to seat limit at this boundary.
testCases.automationReason: Counts are automatable; whether search proceeds may still depend on other required inputs outside passenger scope, but test can at least confirm passenger picker does not prevent saving/continuing at 9.

testCases.title: Negative: Occupied seats exceeds 9 should block Search
testCases.objective: Ensure search cannot proceed when occupied seats (Adults + Children + Infants With Seat) exceed 9.
testCases.confidenceReason: Clarification confirms UI prevents setting pax count above the limit by disabling increment controls; test can assert prevention rather than error messaging on Search.
steps: Enter Abu Dhabi in Origin field
Select Abu Dhabi from airport suggestions
Verify value Adult passenger count equals 9
Verify Child increment control is disabled (cannot exceed total occupied seats limit of 9)
Attempt to increase count Child passengers by 1
Verify value Child passenger count equals 0
testCases.expectedOutcome: When occupied seats already equals 9, additional occupied-seat passenger increments (e.g., Child) are disabled/prevented; total occupied seats cannot exceed 9 and no passenger-validation error message is displayed for this rule.
testCases.automationReason: Disabled state/no-op click and unchanged counts can be asserted reliably; no need to depend on search navigation or error messages.

testCases.title: Derived: Infant With Seat counts toward occupied seats and can trigger >9 block
testCases.objective: Mitigate risk that Infant With Seat is mistakenly excluded from seat-occupancy validation.
testCases.confidenceReason: Clarification confirms limits are enforced in UI; test can validate that adding Infant With Seat is also prevented at the seat cap, proving it is counted as an occupied seat.
steps: Enter Abu Dhabi in Origin field
Select Abu Dhabi from airport suggestions
Verify value Adult passenger count equals 9
Verify Infant With Seat increment control is disabled (cannot exceed total occupied seats limit of 9)
Attempt to increase count Infant With Seat passengers by 1
Verify value Infant With Seat passenger count equals 0
testCases.expectedOutcome: When occupied seats already equals 9, Infant With Seat cannot be incremented (disabled/prevented), confirming Infant With Seat is counted as an occupied seat; no passenger-validation error message is displayed for this rule.
testCases.automationReason: Disabled state/no-op click and unchanged counts can be asserted; avoids dependence on any error message or search navigation.

testCases.title: Verify switching cabin updates passenger summary (if cabin is included in summary)
testCases.objective: Ensure cabin preference change is reflected in the visible selection/summary used for search criteria.
testCases.confidenceReason: Cabin selection is required, but whether summary includes cabin is not specified; test validates visible selection state at minimum.
steps: Verify selected option Cabin equals Business
Verify value Passengers & Cabin control contains Business
testCases.expectedOutcome: Cabin selection persists after closing the panel and is visible on the Passengers & Cabin control (or equivalent summary indicator).
testCases.automationReason: May be fully automatable if the control displays cabin; if not displayed, only internal state is verifiable within the panel.

testCases.title: Verify passenger counts can be decreased and summary updates (non-zero adult maintained)
testCases.objective: Validate decrease functionality and dynamic summary update while keeping at least 1 Adult.
testCases.confidenceReason: Decrease and dynamic summary are explicit; exact min behavior for Adult decrement is unspecified, so this keeps Adult >= 1.
steps: Verify value Adult passenger count equals 2
Verify value Adult passenger count equals 1
Verify value Passenger summary contains Adult 1
testCases.expectedOutcome: Adult count can be increased and decreased; passenger summary updates immediately and reflects the final count of 1 Adult.
testCases.automationReason: Stepper changes and summary updates can be asserted through UI text/state.

stories.coverageSummary: Covers passenger category count management, dynamic summary updates, cabin default and single-select behavior, and proactive UI enforcement for adult minimum, infant-to-adult ratio, and max occupied seats=9. Includes positive, negative, and boundary scenarios with derived risk checks for infant-with-seat seat-occupancy inclusion, verifying control disablement/prevention (no inline/toast/modal errors).

stories.title: Flight Search & Journey Planning

coverage.coverageSummary: Covers default journey type, journey type switching (Round Trip/One-Way/Multi-City), mandatory field validations via Origin/Destination popup behavior (no inline validation messages), origin-destination difference rule, airport search by code/name/city with dynamic suggestions, popular destinations display when empty, nearby airport recommendations visibility (geo-location based), value retention, and a basic responsive check across viewports. Gaps remain around definitive 'active airport' dataset enforcement due to no provided inactive airport fixture and accessibility standards verification due to being out of scope/ignored.
coverage.coverageReason: Homepage URL for widget is now defined and validation behavior is clarified as popup-based without inline messages, improving reliability of automation assertions. Coverage remains reduced because 'only active airports' cannot be validated without a known inactive airport fixture, and accessibility requirements are explicitly ignored.
coveredAreas: Round Trip default selection
Journey type support: Round Trip, One-Way, Multi-City
Origin mandatory validation (popup-based, no inline error message)
Destination mandatory validation (popup-based, no inline error message)
Origin and Destination must not be identical (popup-based, no inline error message)
Airport search supports Airport Code
Airport search supports Airport Name
Airport search supports City Name
Dynamic airport suggestions while typing
Popular destinations shown when no criteria entered
Nearby airport recommendations appear (geo-location based)
Widget retains selected values until modified
Basic responsive behavior across desktop/tablet/mobile viewports
missingAreas: Verification that only active airports are selectable (requires known inactive airport in test data or backend fixture)
Accessibility standards verification beyond basic UI presence (explicitly ignored / not in scope per feedback)

automationReadiness.reason: Homepage URL is now defined, enabling stable entry-point automation. Most scenarios are UI-driven and Playwright-automatable (field selection, suggestions, popup validations, journey type switching, responsive viewports). Readiness remains reduced due to dependency on geo-location for nearby airports (hard to deterministically control) and lack of a known inactive airport fixture to validate 'only active airports'.

stories.coverageSummary: Covers default journey type, journey type switching (Round Trip/One-Way/Multi-City), mandatory field validations via Origin/Destination popup behavior (no inline validation messages), origin-destination difference rule, airport search by code/name/city with dynamic suggestions, popular destinations display when empty, nearby airport recommendations visibility (geo-location based), value retention, and a basic responsive check across viewports.
